text: Simpson's further statements: the paper, the cravat
why: Paragraph 58 gives Simpson's explanation of the paper (a ten-pound note), and paragraph 40 says he could not account for the cravat.
London is already named as where Simpson did his book-making (¶39), and Holmes says the opium was probably brought from London (¶58).
Holmes raises the possibility in ¶58 that the horse may be at the bottom of one of the pits or old mines on the moor.
Paragraph 58 states that Simpson says the paper was a ten-pound note.
Paragraph 58 states that one ten-pound note was found in his purse.
